description: This file facilitates exporting data from various modules within a CRM system, including handling user permissions, constructing export queries, processing export data, and outputting CSV files. It includes functions for preparing data, managing export settings, and exporting data for modules like Accounts, Contacts, Leads, etc.

classes.name: ExportUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing functions to sanitize export data values and retrieve module-specific field information for exporting, including handling picklist and related entity types.

methods.name: br2nl_vt
methods.description: Converts line breaks in text to spaces, used during export for description fields.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Main function to export data for a specified module, constructing queries, fetching data, and outputting CSV content.
